watches.name: Tanjore Edition Bronze [SOLD OUT]
watches.description: [Live from 9th oct 11.00am onwards ships in 3-4 days of placing the order ] TANJORE EDITION BRONZE A WATCH THAT AGES. Some watches are designed to remain exactly as they were when they left the factory. The Tanjore Edition Bronze was designed with a different philosophy. It is a mechanical watch made to change with time, developing a character that becomes uniquely yours. At its heart is the Miyota 8215 automatic mechanical movement , powered by the movement of your wrist. It offers both automatic and hand winding, with an approximate 42-hour power reserve. But the defining character of the Tanjore Edition Bronze comes from its bronze case. A CASE THAT AGES WITH YOU Bronze is a living material. From the moment the watch is being assembled, the case begins to naturally develop a patina. Air, humidity, perspiration, skin contact, climate and the environment around you all influence how the bronze changes. Over time, the case gradually darkens and develops warmer, deeper tones. Different areas may age differently, creating a surface that is entirely individual to the wearer. No two Tanjore Edition Bronze watches will develop exactly the same patina. The ageing is not a flaw. It is the design. Your watch will gradually become a reflection of its journey, carrying the marks of the places you’ve been and the years you’ve spent with it. THE FIRST COROMANDEL WITH A DOMED SAPPHIRE The Tanjore Edition Bronze introduces the first domed sapphire crystal in the Coromandel Watch Co. collection. The pronounced dome gives the watch a distinctly vintage character while creating greater visual depth across the dial and subtle distortion towards the edges. Beneath the crystal is an embossed dial inspired by the maritime heritage of the Coromandel Coast. Two traditional sailing vessels cross the dial, while a nautical compass sits at 6 o’clock. The Coromandel Watch Co. name and hour markers are embossed into the dial, creating a tactile surface that catches and reflects light differently as the watch moves. The hands and hour markers are filled with C3 Super-LumiNova , providing a strong luminous glow in low-light conditions. Texture by day. Lume by night. INSPIRED BY TANJORE The design brings together two important influences. The maritime character of the Coromandel Coast , represented through the sailing vessels and nautical compass. And the architectural heritage of Tanjore , represented on the caseback by an engraving of the iconic Brihadeeshwara Temple , a monument of the Chola era. The Tanjore Edition Bronze combines a 39 mm bronze case with a domed sapphire crystal, 100 m water resistance and a stainless steel screw-down crown. The leather strap is designed to complement the natural warmth of the bronze and, like the case, will develop its own character with use. This is not a watch designed to remain pristine. It is designed to be worn. To travel. To experience different climates, different places and different years. The bronze will remember them. The leather will soften. The patina will evolve. A watch that does not simply tell the story of time. A watch that becomes part of yours. SPECIFICATIONS Movement Miyota 8215 Automatic Mechanical Automatic & Hand Winding Approx. 40-hour power reserve Case CuSn8 Bronze 39 mm diameter 13 mm thickness 20 mm lug width Crystal Domed Sapphire Crystal Dial Embossed dial Embossed sailing vessels Embossed hour markers and branding Nautical compass detail C3 Super-LumiNova hands and hour markers Caseback Stainless Steel Engraved Brihadeeshwara Temple Screw-down caseback Crown Stainless Steel Screw-down Water Resistance 100 metres Strap Leather Packaging Presented in a handcrafted teak wood box. As natural wood varies in grain and texture, each box features its own unique pattern, making every piece one of a kind. Assembly Designed & Hand Assembled in India Warranty Information At Coromandel Watch Co, we take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of our timepieces. All our watches comes with a 1-year war

watches.description: Sale goes Live 4th Nov 11.00am Onwards - Ships Between 10th-15th Nov Bhoomi II is our interpretation of India through mechanical watchmaking. The dial brings together architecture, mythology, wildlife and landscapes into one uninterrupted composition. Inspired by antique Indian murals and finished in warm sepia tones, every glance reveals another detail hidden within the artwork. At the heart of the dial stands the Kalpavriksh , the mythical Tree of Life, rising from an intricately carved stone pedestal and spreading its canopy across the upper half of the watch. To the left sits the majestic Mysore Palace , while the right is dominated by a towering temple gopuram , representing centuries of South Indian temple architecture. Beneath the date window lies the beautifully illustrated stone chariot wheel , inspired by India’s legendary temple craftsmanship, while an Indian elephant walks across the foreground alongside blooming flowers and a blue bird in flight , bringing movement and life to the composition. The artwork is framed by traditional Devanagari numerals , each filled with Japanese C3 Super-LumiNova , allowing the watch to glow brilliantly after dark while preserving its vintage character during the day. Every element has been carefully blended into one continuous illustration, creating a dial that feels less like a watch face and more like a miniature painting. watches.description: [PRE ORDER - Ships between 15-20th June] Ritual on the Wrist In South India, the day does not begin with coffee. It begins with kaappi. The slow drip of decoction, the blend with hot milk, the frothy pour between davara and tumbler. It is aroma, rhythm, memory. The Kaappi Edition captures that everyday ritual in mechanical form. The dial is inspired by freshly ground coffee powder, textured and grainy with a rich roasted tone. Coffee bean shaped hour markers sit proudly on the surface, filled with full Japanese C3 lume. When the lights fade, the beans glow bold and clear. A spoon shaped seconds hand sweeps across the dial, a subtle nod to the final stir before the first sip. For a cleaner and more symmetrical dial layout, this version of Kaappi Edition is released without a date display, while retaining the ghost date movement configuration underneath. The warmth continues with a rose gold finished 316L stainless steel case, echoing traditional brass and copper serveware. A curved sapphire crystal with anti reflective coating ensures clarity in every condition. Turn the watch over and you will find an engraved davara and tumbler on the case back, a quiet detail meant for the wearer alone. Powered by a reliable Japanese GM12 quartz movement and paired with a soft suede leather strap, the Kaappi Edition is built for daily wear with 100 metres of water resistance. Not just coffee its Kaappi.
